Metadata.Name: Data Report Workflow
Metadata.Description: Runs a SQL query against the database, generates a report, and emails the results to stakeholders.
Metadata.Author: Demo

Step.Title: Query Active Users
Step.Description: Pull active user data from the database

Step.Title: User Activity Report
Step.Description: Generate a report from the query results using SQL
Step.Definition: {"report_type":"sql_query","title":"Active Users Summary","sql_query":"SELECT u.full_name, u.email, COUNT(t.id) as task_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN tasks t ON u.id = t.assigned_to_user_id WHERE u.is_active = true GROUP BY u.full_name, u.email ORDER BY task_count DESC","sql_limit":100,"next_step_ids":["step-3"]}

Step.Title: Send Report
Step.Description: Email the report results to stakeholders
Step.Definition: {"to":"admin@example.com","subject":"Weekly User Activity Report","body":"Report generated at $input.executed_at. Total rows: $input.row_count. See attached data.","next_step_ids":[]}
